extracted.name: Scallop and Shrimp Chowder
extracted.description: This scallop and shrimp chowder is made in the slow cooker with corn, onion, and potatoes, making it a fuss-free meal perfect for chilly evenings.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14 ounce) can whole kernel corn, drained
0.5 pound peeled, deveined, and cooked shrimp
instruction_lines: Stir together potatoes, broth, corn, onion, and flour in a 3 1/2-quart slow cooker crock until well combined.
Cook on Low until potatoes are tender, about 6 hours.
Stir cream, scallops, shrimp, potato flakes, and garlic pepper into the crock.
Cook on High until chowder is slightly thickened, 35 to 45 minutes. Season with salt.
